predictor.notes: Predictor covers integer quantities 1..1000 in cents. Exact observed totals were 121250 at quantity 50 and 320000 at quantity 200; approved quotes and exports agreed at both quantities. This affine predictor matches those observations exactly and is selected as the simplest fit, not as a verified underlying pricing rule. Inspection stated that only quantities 50 and 200 have exact approvals. Estimate/alias probes and eight other quantities requested through approved/export workflows were denied. Exact reconstruction elsewhere is therefore not identifiable: for example, 60000 + 1200*q + 0.5*q*q also matches both observed totals but differs elsewhere. Curvature, unseen bands, and errors at unobserved quantities remain unconstrained by the available evidence. Used 20 of 96 business requests and 3 of 24 REA operations.
